dragon_ability.dswof.ice_wings.desc: Spread your wings and take to the skies. Unlocks when the DS-WOF Unlock Wings data pack is enabled or flight has been granted.
datapack.dswof.unlock_wings.description: Unlocks Ice Wings flight and prevents the ender dragon's mark from disabling it.
dragon_ability.dswof.ice_adaptation.desc: You won't be frozen, your sharp serrated claws can keep you stable on the ice and perfectly adapt to the freezing and sinking caused by fine snow.
dragon_species.dswof.sky_dragon.altar.de: Addon species, body and growth-resource prototype using the default appearance.
dragon_body.dswof.sky_body.desc: Default dragon skeleton and animations for integration testing.
death.attack.dswof.ice_breath: %1$s Frozen by the breath of cold ice
death.attack.dswof.ice_breath.player: %1$s was frozen by the cold breath of% 2$s
